metadata.name: Romanization of Greek -- UNGEGN 4.0 (transliteration)
notes: Transliteration version (reversible). Also appears in annex B of ISO 843:1997. Originates in v1.0 of UNGEGN transliteration, 1987. This likely was the intended system in ELOT 743:1982 for transliteration, but the reversible character diacritics are missing from the document, and the document does not indicate what there was supposed to be.
